# Bexley Road schedules 10 doors, not 14

## Context Scope

Appointment capacity at the Bexley Road terminal, for anything sizing the grid or reading a utilisation number off it.

## Fact Statement

Bexley Road has 14 dock doors. Doors 11 through 14 are held for the LTL shuttle, which runs its own cadence and takes no appointments. The appointment grid is therefore 10 wide, and a utilisation figure quoted against 14 understates the terminal by nearly a third.

## Provenance

Walked the dock line with Terry Blake and Sunil Rao on 2026-02-11. Terry named the reservation without being asked about it; it does not appear in the yard system's own door list, which is where the 14 comes from.

## Why This Matters

Portside's first capacity model came in against 14 doors, because that is what the export gave them. Every number downstream of that model — slots per day, expected no-show rate, the pilot's own baseline — is quoted against 10.
